title: Smith Machine Toe Raise
instructions: Set up by placing the Smith Machine bar at shoulder height and adding the weight you want to use.
Grab a step or calf raise block and place it under the bar.
Stand on the block so that your heels are on the front edge of the block, and the top of your feet are hanging off the end.
Grasp the bar with a wide grip and position it across the back of your shoulders (not on your neck).
Push up to take the weight off the rack and slowly allow your toes to drop down as far as possible. This is the starting position for the exercise.
Slowly raise your toes up as far as possible, pause, and then slowly lower them back down.
tips: The Tibialis is a very small muscle and does not need a lot of weight to get a good workout.
Keep the weight low and the rep timing slow for the best results.
